title: Mars' Most Stunning Discovery Yet!

scenes.text: NASA just found volcanic activity in Mars' past!
Large landslides discovered by New Horizons indicate Mars had flowing lava.
This could change our understanding of Martian history.
scenes.label: NEW MARS INSIGHTS!

scenes.text: Follow for the science they never taught you.

description: Discoveries like this reshape how we view the history of Mars! Follow for daily science!
